steps.title: Find a horse
steps.say: Horses live in [plains](biome:plains) and [savannas](biome:savanna). [Donkeys](mob:donkey) live there too, and in [meadows](biome:meadow).

steps.title: Climb on
steps.say: Use the horse with an empty hand to get on. At first it bucks you off.

steps.title: Try again
steps.say: Keep getting back on. Feeding it [apples](item:apple), [sugar](item:sugar) or wheat first helps it calm down faster.

steps.title: Look for hearts
steps.say: When hearts appear, the horse is yours.

steps.title: Get a saddle
steps.say: Craft a [saddle](item:saddle) from 3 [leather](item:leather) and 1 [iron ingot](item:iron_ingot). You can also find them in [chests](item:chest).

steps.title: Saddle up
steps.say: Put the [saddle](item:saddle) on, then get on. Now you can steer, and use jump to leap over [fences](item:oak_fence).

steps.title: Keep it safe
steps.say: Tie your horse to a [fence](item:oak_fence) with a [lead](item:lead) so it does not wander off. [Horse armor](item:leather_horse_armor) protects it.
